### Released handoff oracle

`create0 -> physical authorization1 -> distinct reviewer assignment2 -> distinct selected technician assignment3 -> confirm4 -> arrive5 -> no ownership grant -> first classified raw observation6 -> provenance stage/upload6 -> one retained evidence append7 -> proof issue/read7`.

Before the HTTP handoff read, assert persisted B version `7` and the issued proof candidate-order-version pin `7` as independent literals. Keep the complete exact DTO, literal HTTP200, exact `no-store, private`, proof/status/result/cursor/scope fields, proof-detail and all actor/privacy403 controls. Perform real foreign assignment and retain its exact scoped-empty DTO. Keep the original `DiagnosticContinuityHandoff.spec.ts` literal1 byte-identical.

Do not add public listing state, publication authorization, a grant, response normalization, computed expectations, number matchers, backdating/reset, unsupported seed, other oracle/path or production change. If any additional B mutation is required, stop and return a revised ledger before changing the oracle. F47 and all other stage1 cases retain their existing contracts. The writer may now resume only this held affected offline handoff work in the same checkout; completion returns a clean source/evidence checkpoint for coordinator audit. Runtime remains held.
